visualizations.title: 黄金进位 · 两个 Zeckendorf 表示相加时的进位亏量
visualizations.title_en: Golden carry · the carry deficit when two Zeckendorf representations are added
visualizations.summary: 把 v₁、v₂ 的 Zeckendorf 数字串逐位相加，再一次一条规则地进位。亏量 c(v₁, v₂) = β(v₁) + β(v₂) − β(v₁ + v₂) 在 ℤ[φ] 中精确算出：它是整数，等于最低两条重复进位规则的带符号计数，并且只取 −1、0、1（已由 Lean 内核验证并冻结）。四个场景各看一面：筹码与进位、亏量图、相位正方形、收缩面上长度为 1 的窗口；十张实验卡都可以在正文中单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: Add the Zeckendorf digit strings of v₁ and v₂ digit by digit, then carry one rule at a time. The deficit c(v₁, v₂) = β(v₁) + β(v₂) − β(v₁ + v₂) is computed exactly in ℤ[φ]: it is an integer, the signed count of the two lowest repeated carries, and it only takes the values −1, 0 and 1 (kernel-verified in Lean and frozen). Four scenes show one face each: tokens and carries, the deficit map, the phase square, and the window of length 1 on the contraction face; each of the ten experiment cards can be cited from the text on its own.

visualizations.title: 相位环面 · 把相位正方形粘成环面
visualizations.title_en: Phase torus · the phase square glued into a torus
visualizations.summary: 相位 p(v) = {(v + 1)φ} 只看小数部分，所以相位正方形的对边是同一条线。时间轴把它粘起来：先卷成管子，再弯成环面。颜色是相位判据的三块（已由 Lean 内核验证并冻结），两条斜线 p₁ + p₂ = 1/φ 与 p₁ + p₂ = φ 在环面上首尾相接成一条闭曲线（因为 φ = 1 + 1/φ）。舞台是受光的实体，可以转动；点环面上的珠子换一对数。
visualizations.summary_en: A phase p(v) = {(v + 1)φ} only sees the fractional part, so opposite edges of the phase square are the same line. The rail glues them: first into a tube, then into a torus. The colours are the three regions of the phase criterion (kernel-verified in Lean and frozen), and the two lines p₁ + p₂ = 1/φ and p₁ + p₂ = φ meet end to end into one closed curve on the torus (since φ = 1 + 1/φ). The stage is a lit solid you can turn; click a bead on the torus to change the pair.
